lines.trans: Vanya, we are going to have a third child.
When did you find out about this?
I found out two months ago.
Why didn't you tell me right away?
I thought and doubted for a very long time.
Where would we put a third with such a hard life?
And now I see that everything is improving.
So everything clicked in your head?
Earlier you walked with our young neighbor!

And you immediately changed your decision!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
I can see the toy car.

выходить.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.en: to go out, to come out

examples.trans: I'm going out in a minute.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.en: 'голову оторвать' = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

гулять.gloss: to walk, to go for a walk

meanings.en: to walk, to stroll, to be outside

examples.trans: A girl walks a little dog there.
Let's go for a walk in the park.

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.trans: He talks for a long time.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

meanings.note: verb: Что это значит? = What does it mean?

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

изменить.gloss: to cheat on, to betray; to change

meanings.en: to cheat on, to be unfaithful to

examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you.
When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.

meanings.note: for movement; где is for location
уже месяц = for a month now

examples.trans: I've been living here for a month.
The election is in a month.

examples.text: Молодой человек, как на тест-драйв записаться?
examples.trans: Young man, how do I sign up for a test drive?

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: два года назад = two years ago

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago!

meanings.en: to improve, get sorted out, return to normal

examples.trans: Life is gradually getting sorted out.
Affairs in the company are improving.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

meanings.note: никаких перспектив = no prospects / no future

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.en: to appear, to show up, to turn up

examples.text: Пусть только ещё раз здесь появится!
examples.trans: Let him just show up here one more time!
We came up with a good idea.

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.text: В моей комнате раньше дядя Миша жил.
examples.trans: Uncle Misha used to live in my room.
There used to be an old park here.
I am forced to cancel my decision.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

meanings.en: to converge, fit together, click mentally

examples.text: У меня все сошлось в голове.
examples.trans: It all clicked in my head.

examples.text: Их взгляды сошлись по главному вопросу.
examples.trans: Their opinions converged on the main issue.

meanings.note: next door, or in the same flat

examples.trans: You can see it at once.

meanings.note: выйти на сцену = to go out on stage

meanings.en: scene (in a play, film, or argument)

examples.text: А на сцену выходит — превращается в дерево.
examples.trans: But when she goes out on stage, she turns into a tree.
The actors came out onto the stage.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: ordinal numeral: в третьем поколении = third-generation

examples.trans: He lives on the third floor.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: I'll find out where he is.

meanings.note: short form чисто: всё чисто = everything is clean

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
